description: Realistic analyst questions over the financial-report corpus, graded on ANSWERABILITY rather than rank. The retrieval benchmark (queries.json) asks 'is the gold page in the top 10'; this asks the question that matters to a caller: could the question be answered correctly and completely from the returned payload alone? Wrong attribution (a figure belonging to a different segment, company or year, presented where the answer should be) counts as a failure, not a hit -- it is worse than returning nothing. Reference facts are hand-verified against extracted page text; the judge compares the payload against them and never supplies ground truth itself.

questions.question: How did Google Cloud's operating income change across 2023, 2024 and 2025?
reference_facts: Google Cloud operating income was $1.7 billion for 2023, versus an operating loss of $1.9 billion for 2022
Google Cloud operating income increased $4.4 billion from 2023 to 2024
Google Cloud operating income increased $7.8 billion from 2024 to 2025
questions.confusable_with: Google Services operating income (a different segment, discussed in the same paragraphs: it increased $25.4 billion from 2023 to 2024)

questions.question: How much did Alphabet's Google Services operating income increase in 2024?
reference_facts: Google Services operating income increased $25.4 billion from 2023 to 2024
questions.confusable_with: Google Cloud operating income, which increased $4.4 billion over the same period and appears in the same section

questions.question: How much did Google Cloud revenue grow in 2024 and in 2025?
reference_facts: Google Cloud revenues increased $10.1 billion from 2023 to 2024
Google Cloud revenues increased $15.5 billion from 2024 to 2025
questions.confusable_with: the near-identical sentence in the adjacent fiscal year's filing

questions.question: Compare AWS revenue growth with Microsoft Cloud revenue growth in their most recent fiscal years.
reference_facts: AWS sales increased 19% in 2024
Microsoft Cloud revenue increased 23% to $137.4 billion in fiscal 2024
questions.confusable_with: AWS growth of 13% in 2023 (the prior year)

questions.question: Compare Apple's and Alphabet's research and development spending.
reference_facts: Apple reports research and development expense in its segment reconciliation
Alphabet reports research and development expenses in its income statement and MD&A
questions.confusable_with: returning evidence for only one of the two companies

questions.question: What risks does NVIDIA disclose from US export controls on China?
reference_facts: US government licensing requirements impact exports to China of A100 and H100 integrated circuits and systems incorporating them
NVIDIA ramped new products designed specifically for China that do not require an export control license
Data Center revenue in China as a percentage of total Data Center revenue remains well below levels seen prior to the onset of export controls in October 2023
questions.confusable_with: generic supply-chain or competition risk boilerplate that mentions China without describing export licensing

questions.question: How concentrated is NVIDIA's customer base in fiscal 2026?
reference_facts: For fiscal year 2026, sales to one direct customer represented 22% of total revenue
sales to another direct customer represented 14% of total revenue
questions.confusable_with: the fiscal 2025 figures (12% and two customers at 11%), which appear on the same pages

questions.question: What net income did JPMorgan Chase report for 2022, 2023 and 2024?
reference_facts: JPMorgan Chase reported net income of $37.7 billion for 2022
JPMorgan Chase reported net income of $49.6 billion for 2023
JPMorgan Chase reported net income of $58.5 billion for 2024
questions.confusable_with: a single year's figure presented as if it answered all three

questions.question: Why did Apple's Greater China net sales fall in 2024?
reference_facts: Greater China net sales decreased during 2024 compared to 2023 due primarily to lower net sales of iPhone and iPad
The weakness in the renminbi relative to the U.S. dollar had an unfavorable year-over-year impact on Greater China net sales during 2024
questions.confusable_with: Japan net sales, which increased in the same paragraph

questions.question: How much of its own stock did Apple repurchase in fiscal 2025?
reference_facts: During 2025, the Company repurchased 402 million shares of its common stock for $89.3 billion
questions.confusable_with: the prior fiscal year's repurchase totals in the same note

questions.question: What goodwill impairment charges has AMC recorded, and for which reporting units?
reference_facts: goodwill impairment charges of $1,276.1 million and $1,030.3 million were recorded during the year ended December 31, 2020 for the Domestic Theatres and International Theatres reporting units respectively
questions.confusable_with: the separate $151.2 million and $5.6 million charges recorded as of September 30, 2020

questions.question: When did AMC carry out its reverse stock split and at what ratio?
reference_facts: On August 24, 2023 the Company effectuated a reverse stock split at a ratio of one share of Common Stock for every ten shares of Common Stock
questions.confusable_with: the one-for-ten reverse stock split effectuated by Hycroft on November 15, 2023, described in the same filing

questions.question: How large was Meta's 2022 restructuring and what did it involve?
reference_facts: a layoff of approximately 11,000 employees
facilities consolidation and a pivot in data center strategy were part of the 2022 restructuring

questions.question: What severance charges did Alphabet record for its workforce reduction?
reference_facts: $479 million of charges related to employee severance associated with the reduction in our workforce
questions.confusable_with: the $264 million of employee severance charges reported for a different expense line in the same filing

questions.question: What does Amazon's AWS segment include?
reference_facts: The AWS segment consists of amounts earned from global sales of compute, storage, database, and other services for start-ups, enterprises, government agencies, and academic institutions
questions.confusable_with: the North America or International segment definitions, which sit in the same note
